searchText: The problem with option 2 is that CL should communicate that value for each payload. This isn't what each CL client does today. During sync some CLs are running block_hash validation by themselves and call `newPayload` infrequently to guide EL's sync. So, with option 2 it's not guaranteed that each block will have the max value stored alongside to it, and when the gap is around fork boundary it becomes tricky to decide which max value to use for RPC calls This would be a notable pessimization for Nimbus (and other CLs which do this). And, yes, the ELs could figure out this information, but if they can do that, they don't need it from the CLs at all I put in https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/608 which adds the target gas limit to `engine_forkChoiceUpdated`. If the CL is going to pass the EL the target/max blob counts then it may make sense to add it to this PR, rather than have yet another version of `engine_forkChoiceUpdated` in the near future. **ACDC #147 in ~45 mins!** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1211 Stream: https://www.youtube.com/live/VpYzaCzEVe8 Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/83703239965?pwd=VnjQjZ06LIaCzOjmyY1Jllt0LoTpvK.1 **ACDC #147 Summary** Full summary here: https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/all-core-devs-consensus-acdc-147-december-12-2024/22161/2 Reposting action items here: * Be on the lookout for the Pectra devnet-5 CL specs release! We are near the end of the year, but launching pectra-devnet-5 before EOY would set us up to deliver Pectra to mainnet in a timely fashion in early 2025. * CL teams: ensure your gossip handling follows the 10MB limit in the spec, and keep an eye on gas limit increases over the next few months. * NOTE: the next ACDC on 26 December is canceled. Happy holidays!

excerpts.content:
Reposting action items here:
* Be on the lookout for the Pectra devnet-5 CL specs release! We are near the end of the year, but launching pectra-devnet-5 before EOY would set us up to deliver Pectra to mainnet in a timely fashion in early 2025.
* CL teams: ensure your gossip handling follows the 10MB limit in the spec, and keep an eye on gas limit increases over the next few months.
* NOTE: the next ACDC on 26 December is canceled. Happy holidays!
